Name: Mini-Mods Pack
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
I release a lot of generally quite small mods, so I got to thinking it might be handy to have all of them in one place, in one download, with a unified configuration menu. Nothing revolutionary or particularly clever, just a handy resource for those that want to keep that mod list a bit more manageable. As a look behind the curtain, this wasn't really made for you, as much as it was made for [b]me[/b]!

[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34612/34612-1750962750-9649031.png[/img][/center]
[/u]All of the below items are configurable and, perhaps most importantly, can be installed in place of their source mod without losing anything:

[list]
[*]Can sell fishing rods back to Willy.
[*]Can sell weapons and rings to Clint.
[*]Can choose between 11 Garden Pot appearances, and 5 crafting recipes.
[*]Can obtain miniaturised versions of fruit trees that act as trellis crops. 
[*]Can block Ancient Fruit from the Seed Maker.
[*]Adds two fish tanks and a set of tank caps ranging from 2-17 tiles long to the game.
[*]Can sell the Milk Pail and Shears back to Marnie.
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34612/34612-1750962757-1925483444.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21578]Willy Buys Back Your Rods[/url]﻿ [WBBYR] - Created for [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1210]fireredlily on GitHub[/url]﻿. Simply allows you to sell unwanted Fishing Rods back to Willy, and slightly modifies the prices of the rods, since they were not originally intended to be sold.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33994]Clint Buys Back Your Weapons and Rings[/url]﻿ [CBYWaR] - Seeing as he's a blacksmith, allows Clint to buy your weapons and rings to be melted down. No longer will you have to trudge up to the Adventurer's Guild offload your old equipment.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34217]Dwarf Fruit Trees[/url]﻿ [DFT] - Adds shrunken versions of the vanilla fruit trees (and also coconuts) as regular trellis-like crops.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34240]Garden Pots Galore[/url]﻿ [GPG] - Lets you choose between 11 new Garden Pot appearances, and 5 options for their respective crafting recipe. Reference file included with the .zip file.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34384]Ancient Fruit Banned from Seed Maker[/url]﻿ [AFBfSM] - Created for [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1333]atravita-mods on Github[/url]﻿. Prevents Ancient Fruit from being processed by the Seed Maker. Does not prevent Ancient Seeds from turning up at random when processing [i]other [/i]seeds.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35623]Fish Tank Kits[/url]﻿ [FTK] - Adds two new fish tanks ranging from 2-17 tiles long to the game.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41578]Marnie Buys Back Your Pail and Shears[/url] [MBBYPaS] - Allows you to sell the Milk Pail and Shears back to Marnie.
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34612/34612-1750962763-679336511.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15862]Blue Market Unofficial Quality of Life Patch[/url] - Modifies the external map to change the static trees to actual trees, removes the enforced seasonality of the map, and changes the method for returning from Blue Market to Pelican Town. In addition to being a replacer, and thus not able to easily be turned on/off via config, Blue Market isn't updated for 1.6 and so the patch hasn't either.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15890]Mermaid Island Unofficial Quality of Life Patch[/url] - ﻿Adds a rowboat to Willy's back room to get around an old TrainStation bug, and changes the northern point of Mermaid Island into both the entry and exit point. As with the above, this is a replacer, hasn't been updated for 1.6, and in addition the original mod isn't currently available at all.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33517]Forager's Nooks and Crannies / Stardew Valley Expanded Compatibility Patch[/url]﻿ - Makes a relatively minor change to the SVE version of the Secret Woods to accomodate for the Mystic Forest entrance in Nooks and Crannies. Not included as it's (again) a replacer, and because it has a larger pool of requirements than the rest of the mods in this pack. However, unlike the other two this mod is [b]NOT [/b]retired.
[*][b]More Building Options[/b] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34977]Pack 1﻿[/url]﻿ /[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34981] Pack 2[/url]- Basically it's part of its own pack, and there's no sense triple-dipping compilations.
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34612/34612-1750962779-1674654287.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (Optional, but highly recommended)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿ (Optional, required for Fish Tank Kit catalogue)
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34612/34612-1750962805-1983662264.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]If installing manually, extract [b][CP] Mini-Mods Pack[/b] to your mods folder (if updating, delete any old versions first!).
[*]If using Mod Organiser 2, load the .zip file into MO2 and install as usual.
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do!
[*]If you have any of the [b]seven [/b]mods included in this pack installed already, [i]remove them[/i]. Nothing will break, so long as your config is set up before loading your save.
[/list]
[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/34612/34612-1750962818-1236045662.png[/img][/center]
